title: Investigation of HPV DNA, in-silico validation and role of E6 protein in colorectal carcinogenesis.
authors: Khan, S; Rehman, M Ur; Shakeela, Q; Ahmed, S; Hayat, A
journal: Brazilian journal of biology = Revista brasleira de biologia
one_liner_zh: 该研究主要检测结直肠癌样本中HPV DNA并初步对接E6与P16INK4A蛋白，缺乏TF-DNA互作体系、结合位点预测或动态机理建模，仅边缘涉及蛋白-蛋白对接，与本课题关联度低。
abstract: The human papillomavirus is a prevalent sexually transmitted disease. Studies have shown a connection between HPV and malignancies of the cervix, penis, vulva, vagina, anus, and oropharynx. Colon cancer ranks 10th among all cancers in Pakistan, with 2.7% incidence and 2.4% mortality, while rectal cancer ranks 16th with 1.8% incidence and 1.5% mortality, according to Globocan 2020 data. The native Pakistani population has been progressively affected by colorectal cancer in just four years. The frequency of the disease in males increased threefold, from 2.3 to 6.8%, and in females, from 2.5 to 6.7%. This study was based on 135 paraffin-embedded biopsy specimens collected from several hospitals in Hazara division, Pakistan. Predominantly, the samples were Adenocarcinoma of the colon, rectal squamous carcinoma, and adenoma of the colon. Ten normal biopsy specimens were taken as controls. After processing and treatment with liquid nitrogen, specimens were tested using the GeneXpert PCR to detect HPV DNA and high-risk genotypes HPV16, HPV18, and HPV45. No HPV DNA was found in any of the control samples. 85 (62%) of the 135 specimens had HPV DNA identified, while seven specimens were detected with low-risk genotypes HPV6, HPV11, and HPV55. In the In-silico study, the role of E6 in colorectal cancer development was investigated through pathway analysis. E6 protein structures were retrieved and visualized in MOE 2015.10. The structure of P16INK4A was also retrieved from Pdb, and docking was performed between E6 and P16INK4A to generate a docking complex.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒是一种常见的性传播疾病。研究表明，HPV与宫颈、阴茎、外阴、阴道、肛门及口咽部的恶性肿瘤之间存在关联。根据Globocan 2020数据，结肠癌在巴基斯坦所有癌症中排名第10位，发病率为2.7%，死亡率为2.4%；直肠癌排名第16位，发病率为1.8%，死亡率为1.5%。巴基斯坦本土人群在短短四年内逐渐受到结直肠癌的影响。男性中该疾病的发病率增加了三倍，从2.3%升至6.8%，女性则从2.5%升至6.7%。本研究基于从巴基斯坦哈扎拉分区多家医院收集的135份石蜡包埋活检标本。样本主要为结肠腺癌、直肠鳞状细胞癌和结肠腺瘤。另取10份正常活检标本作为对照。经处理并用液氮处理后，使用GeneXpert PCR检测标本中的HPV DNA及高危基因型HPV16、HPV18和HPV45。所有对照样本中均未检测到HPV DNA。135份标本中有85份（62%）检测到HPV DNA，其中7份标本检测到低危基因型HPV6、HPV11和HPV55。在In-silico研究中，通过通路分析探讨了E6在结直肠癌发展中的作用。E6蛋白结构在MOE 2015.10中获取并可视化。P16INK4A的结构也从Pdb中获取，并在E6与P16INK4A之间进行对接以生成对接复合物。
